queries.name: pymac-part-number
queries.description: Returns PYMAC inventory by part number with optional origin and destination filters.
queries.sql: SELECT pymac.part_number AS part_number, pymac.item_name AS item_name, pymac.origin AS origin, pymac.destination AS destination, pymac.qty_calc AS qty_calc FROM (SELECT itemno AS part_number, MAX(item_name) AS item_name, supplier AS origin, usercd AS destination, SUM(oh_qty) AS qty_calc FROM lymdaact.de_int_im WHERE oh_qty > 0 AND info_date = (SELECT MAX(info_date) FROM lymdaact.de_int_im) GROUP BY itemno, supplier, usercd) pymac WHERE pymac.part_number = :part_number AND (:origin IS NULL OR pymac.origin = :origin) AND (:destination IS NULL OR pymac.destination = :destination)

queries.name: pymac-origin-destination
queries.description: Lists current PYMAC origin and destination codes.
queries.sql: SELECT od.origin_destination AS origin_destination, od.name AS name FROM (SELECT code AS origin_destination, code AS name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(supplier) AS code FROM lymdaact.de_int_im WHERE info_date = (SELECT MAX(info_date) FROM lymdaact.de_int_im) AND TRIM(supplier) <> '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(usercd) AS code FROM lymdaact.de_int_im WHERE info_date = (SELECT MAX(info_date) FROM lymdaact.de_int_im) AND TRIM(usercd) <> '')) od
